note: Skill IDs are ALWAYS English kebab-case. UI labels are bilingual. Never localise an id.

summary.en: Structures content into an arc so the audience follows a line, not a list.
summary.zh-TW: 把內容組織成起承轉合，讓觀眾跟著一條線走，而不是看一堆條列。

summary.en: Defines learning objectives, cognitive load, and assessment points.
summary.zh-TW: 定義學習目標、認知負荷與評量點。

summary.en: Turns an outline into slide-level layout decisions and hierarchy.
summary.zh-TW: 把大綱轉成投影片層級的版面與資訊階層決策。

summary.en: Converts abstract relationships into diagrams a reader can decode without text.
summary.zh-TW: 把抽象關係轉成「遮住文字也看得懂」的圖解。

summary.en: Chooses chart form, encoding, and palette for a dataset and a claim.
summary.zh-TW: 為資料與論點挑選圖表形式、編碼方式與配色。

summary.en: Gathers and cites primary sources; flags unverified claims.
summary.zh-TW: 蒐集並標註一手來源，標示未經查證的主張。

summary.en: Applies tokens, components, and asset rules from a brand pack.
summary.zh-TW: 套用品牌包裡的設計 token、元件與素材規則。

summary.en: Produces illustrations, mascots, and covers under the active style pack.
summary.zh-TW: 在啟用的風格包規範下生成插圖、吉祥物與封面。

summary.en: Adds timing, transitions, and easing to a static composition.
summary.zh-TW: 為靜態版面加上時間軸、轉場與緩動。

summary.en: Renders the output, looks at it, and scores it against the style contract.
summary.zh-TW: 把成品渲染出來、實際看過，再依風格契約評分。

summary.en: Checks overflow, orphan lines, CJK line-breaking, and typos.
summary.zh-TW: 檢查文字溢出、孤行、中文斷行與錯字。

summary.en: Verifies colour, type, spacing, and logo usage against the brand pack.
summary.zh-TW: 比對品牌包驗證色彩、字體、間距與 logo 用法。

summary.en: Consumes QA reports and re-renders until the score clears the threshold.
summary.zh-TW: 讀取品質報告並重新產製，直到分數通過門檻。
